format_section:
# Output format

Your reply is one JSON object written by the scoring engine:
{"fields":{"jdLevel":"...","compStated":"..."},"ratings":{"fit":<integer 0 to 5>,"northStar":<integer 0 to 5>,"level":<integer 0 to 5>,"comp":<integer 0 to 5>,"location":<integer 0 to 5>,"buildDepth":<integer 0 to 5>,"redFlags":<integer 0 to 5>},"after":{"scoreCeiling":"<one of n, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5>","ceilingBasis":"<one of n, c, l, v, b, r, o>","ceilingReason":"..."}}

Each rating is a single digit. Meaning of each rating:
- fit (Fit / CV Match): 0 = worst, 5 = best
- northStar (North Star Alignment): 0 = worst, 5 = best
- level (Level Match): 0 = worst, 5 = best
- comp (Comp): 0 = worst, 5 = best
- location (Location / Logistics): 0 = worst, 5 = best
- buildDepth (Build Depth): 0 = worst, 5 = best
- redFlags (Red Flags): 0 = worst, 5 = best

Fields:
- jdLevel: free text, at most 12 tokens
- compStated: free text, at most 24 tokens
- scoreCeiling: one of n, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (written after the ratings). n means no ceiling; otherwise the highest overall score this role can get
- ceilingBasis: one of n, c, l, v, b, r, o (written after the ratings). the blocker behind scoreCeiling: n none, c comp (pay), l location, v level, b build depth, r a requirement or visa, o other
- ceilingReason: free text, at most 40 tokens (written after the ratings)

Write each text field as plain prose with no quote characters.
